{{Top|leg}}
'''Transport chief''' was a role within the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Roving [[Agent/Legends|agents]] operating undercover, transport chiefs acquired needed supplies for the Alliance and then contracted independent [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to transport the cargo to [[drop point]]s and bases. Although they could not offer much in the way of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] up front, transport chiefs always ensured the spacer had other opportunities available once the cargo was transported, such as further cargo work, provisions, or even [[Starship/Legends|starship]] repairs. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Solla Kyler]] served as a transport chief for the Alliance.<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref>
